_comment: The Palazzo's three officials (0.11.0, docs/palazzo.md §5). Each tells a rumor built from real game data (rumor: 'market' = the counting house's price moves, 'week' = tomorrow's Guild Week day, 'events' = an announced event or the Duke's slowest line), one small favor per player per day (favor: 'raws' = your guild's raw materials, 'goods' = goods your guild makes, 'imports' = another guild's goods up to your rank), and flavor lines. Rewards and sizes: economy.json palazzo. character: the 3D look (client/src/world/blobs.ts).

npcs.name: Ser Benedetto
npcs.title: the Palazzo's notary
npcs.favor_line: The archive needs {items} for ink and seals. I pay fairly, and in writing.
lines: Every contract in Portovela passes under this quill.
A merchant's word is good. A merchant's word with a seal is better.
Read the small print, signore. I wrote most of it.
The Wanted board is mine to keep. Fair prices only, or I strike them out.

npcs.name: Tonio
npcs.title: the town crier
npcs.favor_line: My bell's cracked and my throat is dry. Bring me {items} and I'll cry your name in every street.
lines: I know every price, every quarrel and every wedding in Portovela.
Louder? I can always be louder.
The best news is the news nobody else has heard yet.

npcs.name: Donna Lucrezia
npcs.title: the Duke's steward
npcs.favor_line: His Grace's household is short of {items}. The other guilds make them; I trust you know who to ask.
lines: The Duke notices who helps the city. So do I.
A city is only as rich as its guilds are willing to trade.
His Grace dislikes waiting. I dislike it more.
The Hall of honor has room for one more portrait, I think.
